about_the_game:
“Climb! NYARUMA Action Puzzle” is a unique blend of falling-block puzzle and character action gameplay.

Guide the irresistibly cute creature “Nyaruma” by stacking falling blocks, escaping rising lava, and reaching the goal!

  • A Fresh Twist on Falling-Block Puzzles
    　Line up blocks to slow down the lava and create a platform to guide "Nyaruma".
    　Collect items along the way to power up and open new strategies.

  • Easy to Learn, Fun to Master
    　Simple controls with a built-in tutorial make it accessible for everyone.

  • Global Leaderboards
    　The challenge never ends — the difficulty rises with every clear!
    　Compete with players around the world on the global rankings,
    　and track your own score history to see how far you’ve come.

  • Optimized for PC
    　The original mobile vertical gameplay has been redesigned for widescreen.
    　Enjoy smooth controls with keyboard, mouse, or gamepad support.

Join Nyaruma on this charming and addictive puzzle adventure, and see how high your score can climb!

■ Streaming & Content Creation Policy[/color]

Gameplay videos, livestreams, and other related content are welcome.
Monetization is allowed for both individuals and organizations.

No prior permission is required.
Including a link to the Steam store page in your description is appreciated.

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Ubuntu 20.04 LTS or SteamOS 3.0
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 (4th Gen) or equivalent
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: OpenGL 3.3 / Vulkan-compatible GPU (Intel HD 4000 or higher)
  • Storage: 300 MB available space
linux_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Ubuntu 22.04 LTS or SteamOS 3.0
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 (6th Gen or higher) or equivalent
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 750 / AMD Radeon R7 or higher
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
